note: stock keyboard FIFO consumer: note_on(src=1, note, vel) -> V5 local note hook
stock MIDI parser 0x90: note_on(src=2, note, vel) -> V5 MIDI note-on hook
stock MIDI parser 0x80: note_off(src=2, note) -> V5 MIDI note-off hook
stock HOLD handler: post(msg) with r4 = new hold state -> V5 hold hook
stock keyboard FIFO poll (1 kHz): count = fifo_count(fifo) -> V5 tick hook
stock panel button handler: (id, value 1=press 2=release) -> V5 button hook
stock MIDI CC 123 All Notes Off -> V5 all-notes-off hook
